    Transport

    Sunday 22 November: roads around Sanam Luang close 06.00-12.00 and 15.00-20.30

    21 November 2026·University

    In short

    • 06.00-12.00 Roads around Sanam Luang close, including Phra Chan, Na Phra That and Maharat beside the university.
    • 12.00-15.00 No rehearsal.
    • 15.00-20.30 Roads around Sanam Luang close again. Na Phra That stays closed, but Phra Chan and Maharat are open.
    • Set off earlier and follow the traffic police's directions.

    Contact

    To report something suspicious or an accident, ask about routes or get help with traffic:

    Bangkok traffic police hotline

    24 hours a day

    About the rehearsal

    This is the rehearsal of royal processions 1, 2, 3 and 6 for the royal cremation of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit The Queen Mother. Traffic police manage traffic on each procession's route during its rehearsal time and help people who need to enter the area.

    Source: Metropolitan Police Bureau spokesperson team.
